jobs.title: Commercial & Documentary Video Editor
jobs.summary: Edit commercial, branded and documentary-style video content with strong storytelling, pacing and visual consistency. Strong freshers with quality work and experienced editors are welcome to apply.
jobs.descriptionMd:
We are looking for Commercial & Documentary Video Editors to work across Fixen Media, selected brands and client projects.

This role focuses on longer-form and story-driven video work, including commercial videos, brand films, interviews, documentaries, real-estate videos, corporate productions and campaign content.

We welcome candidates from different experience levels. Strong freshers with solid editing fundamentals and meaningful personal work are encouraged to apply, while more experienced editors may take greater ownership of narrative structure, advanced post-production and complex project delivery.

We value storytelling, pacing, sound, visual judgment and attention to detail more than unnecessary effects.
jobs.responsibilitiesMd:
- Edit commercial, branded, documentary and corporate video content.
- Organize footage, audio and project assets efficiently.
- Build clear narrative structure from raw footage and production briefs.
- Work with interviews, B-roll, voice-over and music.
- Perform pacing, trimming and scene selection based on story and objective.
- Apply basic color correction and maintain visual consistency.
- Clean and balance audio and synchronize dialogue where required.
- Add titles, captions, graphics and supporting elements appropriately.
- Prepare videos for different platforms and delivery specifications.
- Manage revisions and project versions professionally.
- Collaborate with directors, cinematographers, writers and production teams.
- More experienced editors may take ownership of complex storytelling and post-production workflows.
jobs.requirementsMd:
- Strong understanding of video-editing fundamentals.
- Good sense of pacing, continuity and storytelling.
- Working knowledge of professional video-editing software.
- Ability to organize footage and project files properly.
- Basic understanding of color, sound and export settings.
- Ability to work with interviews, B-roll and multiple media sources.
- Attention to detail and visual consistency.
- Ability to interpret creative direction and production briefs.
- Ability to handle revisions professionally.
- A showreel, portfolio, academic project or other demonstrable editing work.

Formal professional experience is not mandatory for applicants with strong practical editing skills and meaningful work samples.
jobs.niceToHaveMd:
- Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve experience.
- Documentary or interview-editing experience.
- Commercial or brand-film editing experience.
- Real-estate video editing experience.
- Basic motion graphics.
- Advanced color correction or grading.
- Sound-design experience.
- Multi-camera editing experience.
- Subtitle and caption workflow experience.
- Experience working with high-resolution or log footage.
benefits: Work on commercial and story-driven productions
Exposure to real client and brand projects
Opportunity to collaborate with production teams
Chance to work across multiple video formats and industries
